headline: Lead Platform Engineer | Cloud Infrastructure
page_title: Rajendra P N - Lead Platform Engineer
summary_html: Lead Platform Engineer with 10+ years of IT infrastructure, DevOps automation, developer enablement, and production operations experience. Designs and maintains Azure infrastructure and AKS platforms using Terraform, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Helm, and Argo CD GitOps. Builds reusable delivery workflows and Python/FastAPI self-service integrations, administers Linux/Unix environments and build agents, and troubleshoots complex platform incidents. Combines PowerShell, Bash, and Python automation with SonarQube, JFrog Artifactory, secure access, observability, release controls, and recovery readiness. Brings GCP/GKE platform knowledge and HIPAA/SOC2 control awareness, with hands-on cloud delivery focused on Azure.

achievements.text: Builds repeatable Azure infrastructure and Kubernetes delivery patterns through reusable Terraform, reviewed changes, secure identity, and operational standards.
Standardizes CI/CD, GitOps, artifacts, build agents, and self-service automation to make application delivery easier to operate and support.
Connects code-quality controls, observability, platform troubleshooting, release recovery, and engineering handoffs across shared infrastructure.

experience.title: Lead Platform/DevOps Engineer
impact: Designed and maintained Azure platform foundations with reusable Terraform modules for networking, identity, storage, and AKS, aligning infrastructure changes with application dependencies and platform standards.
Managed Terraform remote state, environment isolation, plan reviews, and approval controls to keep infrastructure changes reproducible and traceable.
Built reusable Azure DevOps and Jenkins pipeline stages for builds, automated tests, image publication, environment promotion, and post-deployment verification.
Operated AKS application delivery with Helm and Argo CD GitOps, maintaining versioned environment configuration, deployment health checks, and reviewed recovery procedures.
Administered Kubernetes access, workload identity, private service connectivity, certificates, and secrets, using managed identities and Key Vault for protected deployment inputs.
Integrated SonarQube quality feedback, container validation, and artifact promotion controls into release workflows; maintained versioned delivery packages and supporting evidence.
Configured Linux and Windows build agents, diagnosed dependency, cache, credential, and capacity failures, and standardized toolchain prerequisites for reliable execution.
Developed PowerShell, Bash, and Python automation for provisioning checks, operational diagnostics, deployment readiness, and recurring administration tasks.
Integrated Jenkins and SonarQube quality gates with JFrog Artifactory publication, build metadata, and controlled artifact promotion for repeatable application releases.
Deployed Milvus and Qdrant on Azure Kubernetes infrastructure with Helm, configuring persistent storage, resource sizing, access controls, backup procedures, and restore checks.
Provided senior escalation support for complex platform incidents, independently isolating infrastructure, networking, Kubernetes, and pipeline failures and coordinating verified recovery.
Reviewed Kubernetes requests, limits, autoscaling, and node-pool capacity with application owners to improve stability, utilization, and infrastructure cost visibility.
Maintained release recovery checklists, rollback inputs, incident runbooks, and post-incident corrective actions to improve readiness for production disruptions.
Reviewed platform designs and pull requests, mentored engineers, and partnered with stakeholders on standards, roadmap priorities, and technical tool evaluations.
Administered OpenShift application projects, routes, role bindings, and deployment settings; published onboarding patterns and troubleshooting guidance for platform consumers.

Maintained Kubernetes and OpenShift application deployments, configuring Helm values, routes, health probes, resource limits, and recovery steps for shared services.
Automated runner readiness and deployment diagnostics with Python and shell scripts, publishing troubleshooting utilities for application teams.
Protected deployment inputs with Key Vault and least-privilege service connections; validated required checks and documented release handoffs.
Validated reusable workflow changes in isolated test jobs, checking input contracts, artifact paths, and environment settings before adoption by application teams.
